chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Ibn Muskan and Sama'ah, all together, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
You are not yet establishing brotherhood upon this matter, but rather you are being recognised upon it.

key_terms.تَعَارَفْتُمْ: You are being recognised / mutual recognition

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between recognition and brotherhood in Shia Wilayah theology?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the current bond among the faithful is based on mutual recognition (*ta'aruf*) of Wilayah rather than the complete, spiritual brotherhood (*mawakha*) that will characterize the era of the Mahdi. This distinction highlights the transitional nature of the current age, where believers acknowledge their spiritual leaders but have not yet achieved the perfect unity and deep affection promised in eschatological traditions. The narration underscores that true brotherhood is contingent upon the full establishment of divine authority, distinguishing it from the preliminary social and spiritual ties existing today.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Ibn Muskan, and Sama’at, altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:
‘You are not yet establishing brotherhood upon this matter (Al-Wilayah), but rather you are being recognised upon it’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from ibn Muskan and Sama’a all from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
You have not become brothers on the basis of this matter (Walayah the belief of the Shi’a Muslims); it is only that you have recognized each other by means of Walayah .”
